The '''Northern Windfarm''', also known as the '''Geonosian Compound''', was a [[windfarm]] and storage complex in the northern [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Geonosian south warehouse|One]] of the facility's warehouses was used by local criminals to store [[Spice/Legends|spice]], but the [[Farm/Legends|windfarm]] was overrun by members of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the Cold War. The facility fell into disrepair as a result, and in addition to conducting raids on local settlements, the Geonosians occupying the farm were also employed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire to construct [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-borne bombs.

==Description==
The Northern Windfarm was a [[windfarm]] in the [[Deathly Heat]], a region in the northern [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A number of other houses and facilities were located in the area and formed a kind of unofficial [[City/Legends|township]]. The facility occupied a large depression in the sands of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] and consisted of a number of buildings as well five large wind vanes. The largest were two rectangular warehouses; four smaller circular buildings were situated just west of the [[Geonosian north warehouse|northern warehouse]], and one of the buildings was topped by a large [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]]. A [[Geonosian south warehouse|second warehouse]] was located to the southwest, and a large circular tower was situated south of the main farm. The [[Farm/Legends|windfarm's]] five large vanes were situated just north of the farm's buildings, though the farm was taken over by members of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and two of the vanes had collapsed due to disrepair. Three other wind vanes were located south of the southern warehouse, along the edge of the [[Northern Jundland Plateau]].<ref name="Interception" />

==History==
The Northern Windfarm had been in operation before the Cold War but had been abandoned<ref name="Interception" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> when Geonosians took over the windfarm along with most of the region,<ref name="Interception" /> leading to the area being named the Geonosian Compound. Despite the farm's abandonment, the southern warehouse had been used by local criminals to store [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. After taking control of the compound, the Geonosians began to raid nearby settlements.<ref name="Bugged-Out" /> Two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the Geonosians invaded the windfarm, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gorik]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire employed the Geonosian [[Kyvax]] to construct [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-bombs that were used to attack the settlement of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. After learning that the Geonosians were producing the bombs, the elite [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]] [[Havoc Squad]] investigated the warehouse at the Northern Windfarm, where its members encountered Kyvax and overheard a conversation between Kyvax and Gorik that confirmed the Empire's involvement in the bombings. After fighting its way out of the warehouse, Havoc Squad then returned to Anchorhead and continued to track down Gorik.<ref name="Interception" />

Around the same [[Time/Legends|time]], a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] visited the windfarm to set up an [[ultrasonic scanner]] as part of an effort to locate the [[Shock Drum]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] that caused seismic vibrations; the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] fought through the Geonosians in the area and set up the [[scanner]] before departing.<ref name="Race Against Doom" /> Also around that time, the Geonosians from the windfarm attacked the nearby [[Ut'ttailri Jawa Camp]], a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] settlement built around a damaged [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]], and stole parts that the Jawas needed to repair their vehicle. A [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi]] who was searching for the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eriz Vossan]] made a deal with the Jawas to recover their stolen parts in exchange for information on Vossam's whereabouts, and the [[Jedi Consular]] reacquired the parts from around the compound.<ref name="Looking">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Looking Out for the Little Guy|Tatooine}}</ref> A [[Voidhound|smuggler]] was sent to reacquire a tooth from a rare [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] from the southern warehouse for [[Tookreek]], the owner of [[Tookreek's Cantina]] at the nearby [[Dreviad Outpost]], and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] fought through the raiders to find the tooth.<ref name="Bugged-Out" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Northern Windfarm is an area on the planet Tatooine in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. It is visited during the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight class mission "Race Against Doom" and the Jedi Consular mission "Looking Out for the Little Guy,"<ref name="Race Against Doom" /> and the two warehouses are a class-restricted phase for the [[Republic trooper|Trooper]] mission "Interception"<ref name="Interception" /> and the Smuggler mission "Bugged-Out."<ref name="Bugged-Out" />
